config.title: Identity Logon Map
config.query:
IdentityLogonEvents
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where isnotempty(AccountDisplayName) and isnotempty(DeviceName)
| project
    timestamp  = TimeGenerated,
    user       = AccountDisplayName,
    machine    = DeviceName,
    action     = ActionType,
    src_ip     = IPAddress,
    logon_type = LogonType,
    protocol   = Protocol,
    location   = Location
| take 300

config.title: Network Lateral Movement
config.query:
DeviceNetworkEvents
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where ActionType in ("ConnectionSuccess", "ConnectionFailed")
| extend protocol = case(
    RemotePort == 445,  "SMB",
    RemotePort == 389,  "LDAP",
    RemotePort == 3389, "RDP",
    RemotePort == 1433, "TDS",
    RemotePort == 443,  "HTTPS",
    RemotePort == 53,   "DNS",
    tostring(RemotePort))
| project
    timestamp     = TimeGenerated,
    source_device = DeviceName,
    dest_device   = RemoteDeviceName,
    dest_ip       = RemoteIP,
    protocol,
    bytes_sent    = SentBytes,
    action        = ActionType
| take 300

config.title: Email Threat Map
config.query:
EmailAttachmentInfo
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where isnotempty(ThreatTypes)
| project
    timestamp   = TimeGenerated,
    sender      = SenderFromAddress,
    recipient   = RecipientEmailAddress,
    filename    = FileName,
    filetype    = FileType,
    threat_type = ThreatTypes,
    sha256      = substring(SHA256, 0, 16)
| take 200

name: Cloud App Sign-in Risk

config.title: Cloud App Sign-in Risk
config.query:
SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| extend
    result     = iff(ResultType == "0", "Success", "Failure"),
    risk_level = iff(isnotempty(RiskLevelDuringSignIn) and RiskLevelDuringSignIn != "none",
                     RiskLevelDuringSignIn, result)
| project
    timestamp  = TimeGenerated,
    user       = UserPrincipalName,
    app        = AppDisplayName,
    result,
    risk_level,
    location   = tostring(LocationDetails.city),
    ip         = IPAddress
| take 300

name: Process Ancestry Tree

config.title: Process Ancestry Tree
config.query:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where isnotempty(InitiatingProcessFileName) and isnotempty(FileName)
// Focus on suspicious parent processes
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("powershell.exe", "cmd.exe", "wscript.exe", "mshta.exe", "rundll32.exe", "regsvr32.exe", "explorer.exe")
| project
    timestamp      = TimeGenerated,
    device         = DeviceName,
    parent_process = InitiatingProcessFileName,
    child_process  = FileName,
    cmdline        = substring(ProcessCommandLine, 0, 60),
    account        = AccountName
| take 200

config.title: Process File Activity
config.query:
DeviceFileEvents
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where isnotempty(InitiatingProcessFileName) and isnotempty(FileName)
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated", "FileModified", "FileDeleted", "FileRenamed")
| project
    timestamp = TimeGenerated,
    device    = DeviceName,
    process   = InitiatingProcessFileName,
    file      = FileName,
    folder    = FolderPath,
    action    = ActionType,
    account   = InitiatingProcessAccountName,
    sha256    = substring(SHA256, 0, 16)
| take 200

config.title: Registry Persistence Tracker
config.query:
DeviceRegistryEvents
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where RegistryKey has_any ("Run", "RunOnce", "Services", "Startup", "Winlogon", "AppInit")
| where ActionType in ("RegistryValueSet", "RegistryKeyCreated")
| project
    timestamp    = TimeGenerated,
    device       = DeviceName,
    process      = InitiatingProcessFileName,
    account      = InitiatingProcessAccountName,
    registry_key = tostring(split(RegistryKey, "\\")[-1]),
    value_name   = RegistryValueName,
    action       = ActionType
| take 200

config.title: Active Directory Changes

IdentityDirectoryEvents
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where isnotempty(AccountDisplayName) and isnotempty(TargetAccountDisplayName)
| project
    timestamp     = TimeGenerated,

config.title: Cloud App File Activity
config.query:
CloudAppEvents
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where isnotempty(AccountDisplayName) and isnotempty(Application)
| where ActionType has_any ("Download", "Upload", "Share", "Access", "FileDownloaded", "FileUploaded", "SharingSet")
| project
    timestamp = TimeGenerated,
    user      = AccountDisplayName,
    app       = Application,
    action    = ActionType,
    object    = ObjectName,
    ip        = IPAddress,
    country   = CountryCode,
    city      = City
| take 300

config.title: User Risk Events
config.query:
AADUserRiskEvents
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where isnotempty(UserDisplayName) and isnotempty(RiskEventType)
| project
    timestamp       = TimeGenerated,
    user            = UserDisplayName,
    upn             = UserPrincipalName,
    risk_event_type = RiskEventType,
    risk_level      = RiskLevel,
    risk_state      = RiskState,
    ip              = IpAddress,
    detection_type  = DetectionTimingType
| take 200

config.title: Device Logon Failures
config.query:
DeviceLogonEvents
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where ActionType == "LogonFailed"
| where isnotempty(AccountName) and isnotempty(DeviceName)
| project
    timestamp      = TimeGenerated,
    account        = AccountName,
    account_domain = AccountDomain,
    device         = DeviceName,
    failure_reason = FailureReason,
    logon_type     = LogonType,
    process        = InitiatingProcessFileName
| take 200

config.title: DNS Query Graph
config.query:
ASimDnsActivityLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where isnotempty(DvcHostname) and isnotempty(DnsQuery)
| project
    timestamp  = TimeGenerated,
    device     = DvcHostname,
    src_ip     = SrcIpAddr,
    domain     = DnsQuery,
    result     = EventResult,
    query_type = DnsQueryTypeName,
    threat     = ThreatName,
    threat_cat = ThreatCategory
| take 300

config.title: Non-Interactive Sign-ins
config.query:
AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where isnotempty(UserDisplayName) and isnotempty(AppDisplayName)
| extend result = iff(ResultType == "0", "Success", "Failure")
| project
    timestamp  = TimeGenerated,
    user       = UserDisplayName,

    result,

config.title: Process Network Connections
config.query:
DeviceNetworkEvents
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where ActionType == "ConnectionSuccess"
| where isnotempty(InitiatingProcessFileName) and isnotempty(RemoteIP)
| where RemoteIP !startswith "10." and RemoteIP !startswith "192.168." and RemoteIP !startswith "172."
| project
    timestamp  = TimeGenerated,
    device     = DeviceName,
    process    = InitiatingProcessFileName,
    remote_ip  = RemoteIP,
    remote_url = RemoteUrl,
    port       = tostring(RemotePort),
    action     = ActionType,
    bytes_sent = SentBytes
| take 200

| where isnotempty(AccountDisplayName) and isnotempty(DeviceName)
| where Protocol in ("Kerberos", "NTLM", "PKU2U")
| project
    timestamp  = TimeGenerated,
    user       = AccountDisplayName,
    machine    = DeviceName,
    protocol   = Protocol,
    action     = ActionType,
    logon_type = LogonType,
    location   = Location,
    ip         = IPAddress
| take 300
